evidence.family_discrimination: yolo11 n/s: neck C3k2 = Bottleneck x3 + C3k on the last layer; yolo11 m/l/x: all C3k; yolo26: C3k x3 + a PSABlock-based C3k2 on the last neck layer at every scale.  The two families differ structurally at every scale, not only in width, so their tails cannot be swapped.  Both facts come from the native parse_model rules, not from hardcoded flags.
